g.text: Changing frontiers keep their original labels
A unary root v and a nullary child w: no external leaves
Frontier arity: 0 → 1 → 1
Then contract the joining edge: arity stays 1.
Same completed ideal; a new original edge label.
This contraction is a genuine nonidentity arrow.
Fix the initial object; retain all original arrows
P_a = (a ↓ E_n)
First face: its initial image is f₁, not 1_a.
Graft terminal: completed graft → corolla
Its original joining-seam contraction remains.
Use the whole compatible index, including joint transitions.
Extend the original full section homotopy
D = U − V; δR = DΣ
J = DH + RQ
δJ = D; JΣ = R
The actual R(y) = z is preserved.
Deleting RQ leaves a positive-parameter defect +z.
All equations are on full typed parameter maps.
Original refinement, endpoint factors and Hom identity: Theorems 46–47.
Nullary frontier and nonzero original section value: Exercises 46–47.
Full marked graph constructions and signs: Theorems 24–27, 37, 43–45.
